description: Demolition of overhanging first-floor side extension and associated support columns, erection of  three-storey plus basement side infill extension, including repositioning of ground-floor entrance door; erection of second-floor bay window extension above rear bay window projection; lowering of basement level by approximately 640 mm, together with associated alterations to basement fenestration, including relocation of basement door opening from rear lightwell to front lightwell to form French doors, removal of window security bars; insertion of windows in side elevation at ground and second-floor levels; removal of render from first-floor rear bay window projection; reinstatement of decorative quoins at junction of front and side elevations; reconfiguration of rear lightwell incorporating enlarged carport with recessed bin stores beneath; reconfiguration of front lightwell incorporating stepped planters, relocated steps, and extended front boundary wall;  replacement of all single-glazed timber sash windows with double-glazed timber sash windows to match existing
